{
  "categories": [
    {
      "name": "ipc",
      "member": true,
      "evidence": "Adds an Events IPC interface over Cap'n Proto and implements serialization handling in events-types.h",
      "band": "P2",
      "score": 0.6,
      "reason_tag": "new feature",
      "rationale": "Adds a pull-based Cap'n Proto Events interface that delivers an ordered stream of block and mempool notifications. This directly addresses long-standing external client pain points with ZMQ notifications, such as dropped intermediate blocks during fast updates and the inability to distinguish mempool entry from block inclusion (cites PR #19462, PR #23624, PR #7753)."
    },
    {
      "name": "mempool",
      "member": false,
      "evidence": "Updates internal sequence reporting on removal solely to feed the IPC notification stream rather than altering mempool policy or validation data structures",
      "band": "Unranked",
      "score": 0.0,
      "reason_tag": "cleanup",
      "rationale": "The change does not alter mempool acceptance, replacement, eviction rules, or policy behavior."
    },
    {
      "name": "mining",
      "member": false,
      "evidence": "Does not touch block template construction or interfaces::Mining",
      "band": "Unranked",
      "score": 0.0,
      "reason_tag": "cleanup",
      "rationale": "The PR provides general chain and mempool event notifications rather than mining template assembly or miner-facing interfaces."
    },
    {
      "name": "p2p",
      "member": false,
      "evidence": "Does not touch network transport, peer management, or p2p protocol messages",
      "band": "Unranked",
      "score": 0.0,
      "reason_tag": "cleanup",
      "rationale": "The change concerns external IPC notifications rather than peer-to-peer network relay or connectivity."
    },
    {
      "name": "rpc",
      "member": false,
      "evidence": "Does not alter JSON-RPC, REST, or existing ZMQ endpoints, operating exclusively across Cap'n Proto IPC",
      "band": "Unranked",
      "score": 0.0,
      "reason_tag": "cleanup",
      "rationale": "Although motivated by shortcomings in ZMQ, it introduces a separate IPC-based event mechanism instead of modifying the RPC/REST/ZMQ subsystems."
    },
    {
      "name": "utils",
      "member": false,
      "evidence": "Does not modify shared utilities, logging, or core library primitives",
      "band": "Unranked",
      "score": 0.0,
      "reason_tag": "cleanup",
      "rationale": "Type conversions and buffering logic are implemented specific to the IPC interface rather than common node utilities."
    },
    {
      "name": "validation",
      "member": false,
      "evidence": "Does not alter consensus rules, chainstate management, or validation logic",
      "band": "Unranked",
      "score": 0.0,
      "reason_tag": "cleanup",
      "rationale": "Consuming block connection and disconnection events to push IPC notifications does not touch validation code or invariants."
    }
  ],
  "factors": {
    "security_stability": 0,

    "leverage": 1
  }
}
